# helm

<!-- Generated by bazel run //tools/docs/languages:languages_bin -- --write from helm/lang.json and helm/defs.bzl. Do not edit. -->

## Install

Add `rules_dx` to `MODULE.bazel`:

```python
bazel_dep(name = "rules_dx", version = "<version>")
```

Load the rules from `@rules_dx//helm:defs.bzl`:

```python
load("@rules_dx//helm:defs.bzl", "helm_chart")
```

## Rules

### `helm_chart`

Owns one Helm chart, the package holding Chart.yaml, for dx lint.

| Attribute | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `subcharts` | `label_list` | no | Vendored subchart archives under charts/; never fetched. |
| `namespace` | `string` | no | Namespace passed to helm template. |
| `release_name` | `string` | no | Release name passed to helm template; at most 53 characters. |
| `srcs` | `label_list` | no | Chart files, including Chart.yaml and templates. |
| `values` | `label_list` | no | Values files in order; later files override earlier ones. |
